meta_description:
techhelpindia on October 27, 2025: "Naya laptop to le liya… par uski asli power check ki kya? 💻⚡
Bas ek simple command aur aapko mil jayega system ka real performance score!

👉 Command: Get-CimInstance Win32_WinSat

No app, no tool — sirf ek line PowerShell me likho aur pata lagao apka laptop beast hai ya bas average.🔥
Try karo aur comment me apna score likhna mat bhoolna! 👇

💡Score Meaning:
🔹 1.0 – 2.9: Basic tasks (Browsing, Email, Word)
🔹 3.0 – 3.9: Light multitasking & HD streaming
🔹 4.0 – 4.9: Moderate gaming & casual content creation
🔹 5.0 – 6.9: HD editing, smooth multitasking, graphic work
🔹 7.0 – 9.9: High-end gaming, 4K video editing, rendering beast 🚀

Ab laptop lene ke baad testing bhi smart way me karo! 😉
.
#LaptopTips, #TechFacts, #WindowsTricks 
(laptop performance test, windows hidden feature, powershell performance command, check laptop power score, windows system score command, laptop tips hindi, tech help india reels, windows trick 2025, pc performance test)".
